name: Feeler lash
description: The survivor's antenna thrown as a whip. Same tapered shaft and sensing nub as `ss.lib.antenna`, drawn at the length it reaches mid-swing rather than the length it sits at — this is the feeler in motion, not a weapon it holds. Rooted at the socket (anchor bottom-centre) so the game can hang it off the shell and flip it by facing. The canvas is the swing, not the body: nothing here has to fit inside a 32px survivor, which is the whole reason this is its own document rather than another track on the character's antenna.

dead.description: A survivor's lash — the feeler still works as a whip even with nothing on the air to read.

whip.description: one crack: the shaft swings down through most of a half-circle, the tip outruns it and snaps back, and the trail marks the arc it went through and is gone before the shaft has finished
